title: Reconcile GitHub issue-comment response schema and governed Admin dispatch parity

phases.objective: Align the existing active/ready github_create_issue_comment SQL endpoint with the canonical GitHub 201 response contract and expose that same reviewed endpoint through the existing admin-only github_rest_endpoint_dispatch surface without weakening mutation governance, silently choosing ambiguous registry rows, or creating a second execution path.

e2e_journeys.actor: Platform admin discovering, preflighting, approving, executing, and reading back the canonical GitHub issue-comment mutation through the governed registry dispatcher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exactly one existing active/ready POST issue-comment endpoint retains a 201 JSON object response schema, appears in exactly one intended admin-only export and dispatch binding, cannot reach provider dispatch until explicit approval, completed preflight evidence, live execution approval, and the exact readback policy survive normalization, and after a successful POST is not reported as governed success until the exact created comment id is observed through github_list_issue_comments in the same execution cycle.
steps: Count the exact canonical endpoint and exact enabled Admin dispatcher candidates before any registry mutation; proceed only when both cardinalities are exactly one.

Use the existing github_create_issue_comment endpoint row with a non-null canonical endpoint_id; do not register a replacement endpoint or accept caller-supplied method, URL, or authorization material.
Reconcile responses.201 on that exact active/ready POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/comments row with the response class already defined by the canonical compiled GitHub schema.

Add github_create_issue_comment to the existing canonical github_rest_endpoint_dispatch endpoint-key allowlist only when absent without tightening the shared pull-request body field used by other GitHub operations.

Create or repair one admin platform endpoint export whose logical identity and source_endpoint_id point to the exact canonical endpoint and whose input_schema_json is copied from endpoints.schema_json.

Create or repair one active db_admin_tool dispatch binding for github_issue_comments_write / github_issue_comment_create using the same export and endpoint source identity through runtime_endpoint_call.

Use runtime_endpoint_preview for no-provider-call preflight; a direct preflight_only create-comment request cannot fall through to provider dispatch, and the public dispatcher rejects dry-run/preflight mutation calls with preview guidance.

For github_rest_endpoint_dispatch, carry mutation approval, completed preflight evidence, and live_execution_approved inside readback.governance so the evidence survives normalizePlatformEndpointCallArgs; top-level-only governance evidence is rejected for this dispatcher path.

Before any live provider dispatch, executionFacade requires explicit mutation approval, completed preflight evidence, live_execution_approved, and readback.required=true with policy_key=github_issue_comment_exact_readback_v1.

After a successful create-comment response, executionFacade extracts the returned comment id, performs a same-cycle github_list_issue_comments read using the same repository/issue path context, and verifies that exact id is present. Missing identity, readback failure, or non-observation fails closed without automatic retry and without claiming governed success.
Use v_platform_endpoint_export_schema_parity for general export parity and v_github_issue_comment_dispatch_parity for exact endpoint/201/allowlist/export/binding post-apply readiness.
assertions: The canonical compiled GitHub schema already declares createIssueComment with a 201 Created application/json Comment response.

The migration updates only the existing github_create_issue_comment endpoint selected by exact parent action, endpoint key, non-null endpoint_id, POST method, issue-comments path, active status, ready execution state, and http_generic_api transport.

Endpoint or canonical Admin dispatcher candidate cardinality other than exactly one prevents endpoint and dispatcher mutation as well as export/binding creation; there is no first-row selection or partial endpoint-only apply.
The canonical Admin dispatcher identity includes POST /system/tools/call with fixed_body.name=runtime_endpoint_call rather than relying on tool_key alone.
The migration does not INSERT a new endpoints row and therefore cannot create a competing provider-operation identity.
The SQL endpoint receives a responses.201 application/json object schema that tolerates additive GitHub comment fields.
The Admin dispatcher allowlist gains github_create_issue_comment idempotently without adding minLength to the shared body.body property, so unrelated operations can still clear a pull-request body.
The export upsert repairs export_key, parent_action_key, endpoint_key, tenant_id, source_endpoint_id, and schema parity to the canonical admin identity.
The binding upsert repairs binding_id, parent_action_key, endpoint_key, tool_key, export/source identity, and remains registry-driven through runtime_endpoint_call.

The actual executionFacade used by runtime_endpoint_call enforces the create-comment mutation gate before provider dispatch, so the Admin dispatcher cannot bypass approval/preflight/live/readback requirements.
A preflight_only create-comment request without dry_run fails closed during target classification before provider dispatch; runtime_endpoint_preview remains passive because it supplies dry_run=true.

For github_rest_endpoint_dispatch, top-level mutation approval/preflight/live evidence is not accepted as authoritative because the platform endpoint normalizer does not preserve those unrelated top-level fields; the required evidence is nested in readback.governance, which is preserved intact into executionFacade.

The projected multi-binding schema publishes an endpoint-specific github_create_issue_comment condition requiring readback.governance approval/preflight/live evidence and the exact readback policy without changing other GitHub endpoint contracts.
Only the exact readback policy key github_issue_comment_exact_readback_v1 satisfies the live gate; arbitrary non-none modes do not authorize a provider write.

After a successful provider write, executionFacade performs an executable same-cycle read through github_list_issue_comments and verifies the exact provider-returned comment id before returning governance_readback.status=verified.

If the provider response lacks a comment id, the readback call fails, or the exact id is not observed, execution returns a typed no-secret governance error with mutation_executed=true and automatic_retry_allowed=false rather than claiming verified success.
Read-only GitHub endpoint bindings remain unaffected by the create-comment-specific live mutation gate.

v_github_issue_comment_dispatch_parity returns ready only when exact ready/http_generic_api endpoint identity, 201 response schema, canonical Admin dispatcher allowlist, source-bound export schema parity, and a binding joined to that same export and endpoint all converge to one; otherwise it returns blocked.

No provider call, credential payload read, raw secret access, external send, external write, DB migration apply, Production mutation, generated-artifact edit, force push, PREPARE, or EXECUTE is performed by the source change itself; provider calls occur only when the governed runtime tool is invoked later with the required authority and evidence.
This bounded change closes only github_create_issue_comment registry/export/runtime-readback parity; it does not claim full platform catalog/runtime/certification parity or close #4451.
